def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("white car")
    street_patches = image_patch.find("street")
    plaza_patches = image_patch.find("plaza")

    if not car_patches or not street_patches or not plaza_patches:
        return []

    # Find streets surrounding the plaza
    surrounding_streets = []
    for street in street_patches:
        if any(is_between_3d(street, plaza, p) for p in plaza_patches):
            surrounding_streets.append(street)

    # Filter cars that are on the surrounding streets
    cars_on_surrounding_streets = [car for car in car_patches if any(is_between_3d(car, street, s) for street in surrounding_streets for s in plaza_patches)]

    return cars_on_surrounding_streets
